_about: Proposed D43 group entries for salary, portfolio and profession plans, 2026-11-04. Shaped like data/fees/discount@2026-11-04.json groups.entries, plus three proposal-only fields per entry: document_kind (binding | page_terms | advertising), document_dates, and library ids. Short strings use the schema's names who_short_he, cheaper_he, ends_short_he (ends_short_he is the brief's until_short_he). Every quote was checked against the filed copy by script. advertising_only lists plans with no binding document and no printed price, for the house's page or left_out, never for a sub-row price. Nothing here was written to data/.

advertising_only.library: none (host refuses curl; read in Chrome by the earlier researcher)
advertising_only.why: The plans' securities prices are binding (tariff 26.7.26, annex ו': ONE 0.1% min 10 NIS in Tel Aviv, 0.1% min 8 USD abroad, conversion fee exempt; ONE+ 10 free trades a month, then the same), but they belong to anyone paying 49 or 89 NIS a month, and the record already prices them as plan lines. Only the salary waiver of the plan fee is advertising, with no terms found.
